value.answer: This needs emergency care now - go to the ER, even if your baby looks well. At this age a temperature of 38C or higher can be the only sign of a serious infection. Please don't wait to re-check, and don't give any medicine before they're seen.
value.triage: Go to the ER now. Call 911 right away if there is a seizure, fast or hard breathing, blue or gray lips, a rash that doesn't fade under pressure, or your baby is limp, hard to wake, or can't feed. Call 811 if you need help getting there.
